articles.title: Love, Lies & Acid: Sambhal Teacher Attack’s Twisted Conspiracy Exposed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh – A shocking revelation has surfaced in the Sambhal acid attack case. Police investigations have confirmed that the brutal attack on inter-college teacher Bhavna was orchestrated by her fiancé’s ex-girlfriend, Jahnvi, who manipulated a youth into carrying out the...

body.html:
Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh – A shocking revelation has surfaced in the Sambhal acid attack case. Police investigations have confirmed that the brutal attack on inter-college teacher Bhavna was orchestrated by her fiancé’s ex-girlfriend, Jahnvi, who manipulated a youth into carrying out the crime.

According to SP Krishna Kumar Vishnoi, Jahnvi, a married woman and mother of two, plotted the attack out of jealousy and revenge. She created a fake social media identity as “Dr Archana” to trap Neeshu, a resident of Amroha. Promising marriage, she conditioned him to throw acid on Bhavna, whose wedding was fixed with an Army soldier posted in Kolkata.

On Tuesday afternoon, Neeshu attacked Bhavna in Sharifpur village under Nakhasa police station limits, leaving her with 25% burns on her face, neck, and stomach. Local residents rushed her to hospital in critical condition.

Police tracked Neeshu 15 km from the crime scene. When surrounded, he opened fire. In retaliatory firing, he was shot in both legs and later arrested. At the hospital, he pleaded for mercy with folded hands, but the SP sternly told him, “Folding hands won’t help now, son… the one above will deliver justice.”

During interrogation, police uncovered Jahnvi’s elaborate conspiracy through Instagram chats, fake profiles, and call records. She was arrested and sent to jail. The charge sheet will be filed soon.

The incident has triggered outrage across Uttar Pradesh, exposing dangerous misuse of social media and emotional exploitation in the planning of violent crimes.

articles.title: Azamgarh Horror: 7-Year-Old Found Dead in Sack, Neighbour Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking crime has shaken the district after the body of seven-year-old Shazeb Ali was found stuffed in a sack and hanging from a tree near his house on Thursday, September 25.

body.html:
Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking crime has shaken the district after the body of seven-year-old Shazeb Ali was found stuffed in a sack and hanging from a tree near his house on Thursday, September 25.

The child, son of Mukarram Ali, had gone missing the previous day, and his family had lodged a missing complaint. The accused has been identified as neighbour Sandeep Nigam alias Mantu.

Police said Shazeb’s family had also received a ransom call on Thursday morning. Hours later, his body was discovered. SP Dr Anil Kumar confirmed that a land dispute between the families is also being investigated.

The boy’s mother Jasmeen, inconsolable, demanded justice: “I want CM Yogi Adityanath to bulldoze this house, and if he does not, we will do it.” The family and locals have also demanded the accused’s house be razed.

Relatives alleged police delay in registering the missing complaint worsened the tragedy. Heavy police deployment has been made to prevent communal tensions.

The body has been sent for post-mortem, and forensic teams are probing the case.

articles.title: Karur Rally Stampede: 39 Dead, Outrage Over Vijay’s Response
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Karur, Tamil Nadu: A massive stampede at TVK chief and South Indian actor Vijay’s political rally in Karur on September 27, 2025, left at least 39 people dead and over 50 injured, including women and children.

body.html:
Karur, Tamil Nadu:
A massive stampede at TVK chief and South Indian actor Vijay’s political rally in Karur on September 27, 2025, left at least 39 people dead and over 50 injured, including women and children.

The tragedy unfolded when tens of thousands of supporters surged toward barricades during Vijay’s speech. Officials said the rally had nearly 60,000 attendees—double the expected capacity—creating dangerous overcrowding.

Police confirmed Vijay departed soon after the incident via Trichy airport on a chartered flight, sparking widespread outrage. Critics accused him of failing to meet victims’ families or visit hospitals before leaving. Four hours later, Vijay issued a social media statement expressing deep sorrow: “My heart is shattered… I extend my deepest condolences to the families of my dear brothers and sisters who lost their lives in Karur.”

Despite his message, backlash continued over the perceived insensitivity of his response.

Chief Minister MK Stalin announced ₹10 lakh compensation for the families of the deceased and ₹1 lakh for the injured, and appointed former Justice Aruna Jagadeesan to head a one-man inquiry commission. Senior officials and ministers were dispatched to oversee relief and probe efforts.

The incident has drawn nationwide attention, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu offering condolences and demanding accountability.

Prominent film personalities, including Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan, expressed grief, while demands grew for stricter crowd management at political rallies.

Karur remains in shock as authorities continue rescue, relief, and investigation measures in what is now one of the deadliest stampedes in recent Indian political history.

body.html:
Amroha, Uttar Pradesh: A high-voltage drama unfolded during the Gajraula Municipal Council board meeting on Thursday (25 September 2025) when a heated argument escalated into physical assault.

According to reports, a woman councillor slapped and grabbed former MLA Harpal Singh by the collar, also landing kicks and punches in front of police officials. Singh, who is the husband of the municipal chairperson, had arrived with his wife at the meeting, sparking tensions among councillors.

Police intervened and separated the two, later escorting Harpal Singh out of the meeting hall. Following the scuffle, his health reportedly deteriorated and he is currently under treatment in Meerut.

Authorities confirmed that cross FIRs have been registered in the case. The incident, caught on camera, has gone viral, adding to the controversy. Police said a probe is underway.

body.html:
Bandra, Mumbai: A woman in her early 30s has recounted a terrifying incident of street harassment in Bandra, sparking concern among residents and online users. Writing on Reddit under the title “Never expected Bandra to be Unsafe. Rant,” she said a man grabbed and groped her on a crowded, well-lit road around 7:45 pm while she was running errands.

The woman, who emphasised dressing modestly, said the harassment was not an isolated event. She reported being followed home multiple times and catcalled in the past months. In the latest incident, she screamed and hit the man with her tote bag until he released her and apologised repeatedly.

She later updated the location to near Peace Haven bungalow on Perry Cross Road. The post drew widespread reactions, with many users sharing similar experiences and urging her to report the matter to the police. As of now, no formal complaint or arrests have been confirmed.

The incident has reignited debates about public safety for women in Bandra, a bustling suburb frequented by shoppers and office-goers.

articles.title: Lucknow Horror: Man Beaten to Death by Girlfriend’s Brothers Over Love Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh: In a shocking case of violence over a love affair, 27-year-old Ali Abbas was brutally beaten to death by his girlfriend’s brothers in the Saadatganj area of the city. Police have arrested three accused in connection with the murder.

body.html:
Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh: In a shocking case of violence over a love affair, 27-year-old Ali Abbas was brutally beaten to death by his girlfriend’s brothers in the Saadatganj area of the city. Police have arrested three accused in connection with the murder.

According to DCP (West) Vishwajeet Srivastava, the incident occurred on Monday night when the accused — Himalaya Prajapati (26), Sonu Prajapati (27), and Saurabh Prajapati (30) — called Abbas to their home under the pretext of discussing their sister’s marriage. Ali and the girl had been in a relationship for four years, which the family strongly opposed.

Once he arrived, the accused allegedly attacked him with sticks, leaving him with severe head injuries. Later, they dumped him in an alley. The victim’s family rushed to the spot and tried to take him to a trauma centre, but he died on the way early Tuesday morning.

Following a complaint by Abbas’s father, Arif Zameer, police registered a case of murder under IPC Section 302 against the three brothers. All have been arrested, and forensic teams have collected evidence from the crime scene. Investigations are ongoing.

articles.title: Indore Man Tries to Run Over Ex on Activa After She Refuses to Reconcile
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore: In a shocking incident in Kalpana Nagar on Wednesday evening (September 24), a young man allegedly ran over his ex-girlfriend with a speeding Activa after she refused to resume their live-in relationship.

body.html:
Indore: In a shocking incident in Kalpana Nagar on Wednesday evening (September 24), a young man allegedly ran over his ex-girlfriend with a speeding Activa after she refused to resume their live-in relationship.

According to Hiranagar police station in-charge Sushil Patel, accused Rajendra Chaurasia first confronted the woman on the street, insisting on living together again. When she refused, an argument ensued. Angered, Rajendra left but soon returned on a speeding Activa and ran over her. The woman tried to defend herself by picking up a stone, but he did not stop and fled the scene. Passersby helped the injured woman.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, and the woman has filed a complaint. Police have registered cases of molestation and attempted murder against Rajendra, who reportedly has seven prior criminal cases. He is currently absconding.

Preliminary investigation revealed that the woman and Rajendra had previously lived in a live-in relationship. Rajendra, who was addicted to drugs, had displayed violent behaviour, prompting the woman to end the relationship and move to Mumbai for work. After returning to Indore following her father’s death, she became a target of Rajendra’s harassment.

The police recorded the woman’s statement at the hospital and conducted a raid at Rajendra’s residence on Wednesday night, but he could not be apprehended.
